facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.init_distributed: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group using NCCL backend with SLURM or manual rank and world size

facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.AllReduce: perform a normalized all-reduce average across all processes by dividing by world size before reducing

facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.gpu_timer: time a closure's GPU execution using CUDA events and return the result with elapsed milliseconds
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.get_logger: create a configured Python logger with a custom format and optional name for structured log output
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.CSVLogger: create a CSVLogger instance to write typed header rows and data rows to a CSV file
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.AverageMeter: create an AverageMeter to track running average, min, max, and current value of updated metrics
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.grad_logger: compute gradient norm statistics across model parameters including first and last layer qkv norms

facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.create_resource_monitoring_thread: create a ResourceMonitoringThread to monitor a process PID for CPU and IO stats at a set interval
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.start_resource_monitoring: start a ResourceMonitoringThread to collect resource stats samples for a given process PID
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.stop_resource_monitoring: stop a running ResourceMonitoringThread by calling its stop method to halt sampling
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.create_resource_stats_sample: create a ResourceStatsSample dataclass to hold CPU, IO, and thread metrics for a process
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.review_compress_cpu_affinity: review the compress_cpu_affinity helper that converts a CPU affinity list into a compressed range string

facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.init_tensor_truncated_normal: initialize a PyTorch tensor with truncated normal distribution values using trunc_normal_
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.apply_masks_select_patches: apply masks to select specific patches from a batched tensor using apply_masks
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.repeat_interleave_batch_rows: repeat and interleave batch segments of a tensor using repeat_interleave_batch
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.review_trunc_normal_implementation: review the trunc_normal_ function and its inverse CDF transform approach for truncated normal sampling
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.summarize_tensor_utils: summarize the tensor utility functions for masked patch selection and batch repetition

facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.create_video_transform: create a VideoTransform instance with configurable augmentation options for video frame processing
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.make_transforms_factory: build a VideoTransform using the make_transforms factory function with custom crop size and normalization
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.apply_video_augmentation: apply spatial transforms, horizontal flip, and normalization to a video frame buffer tensor
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.normalize_tensor: normalize a PyTorch tensor by subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation
facebookresearch_jepa-intuitive-physics/.normalize_tensor_inplace: normalize a C T H W tensor in-place using mean and std values scaled to 0-255 range
